english:
Travels along a very light arc with strong tracking towards allies. Grants <solar Cure x1 /> to you and allies who are within 7.5 meters of the impact site and creates a Restoration Orb there on impact.

The Orb lasts 7.5 seconds, has 100 HP, and can be picked up within 7.5 meters to grant <solar Restoration x1 /> for 4s (6 with <solar Ember of Solace />).

source.text:
Very Light Trajectory | Strong Ally Homing

Applies Cure x1 to the user and allies within 7.5 metres of impact, and creates a Restoration Orb that lasts 7.5 seconds.

Restoration Orb applies Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds upon being picked up. Orb has a 7.5 meter pickup radius, and 100 HP.
Base Cooldown: 119.7 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.875x
